europe_now.title: Italy Fines Meta Over Privacy Violations
europe_now.summary: Italian authorities have issued a substantial financial penalty against Meta regarding the handling of user photos and privacy compliance. The enforcement action highlights ongoing regulatory scrutiny of major technology platforms within the European Union.

sources.headline: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
Italy hits Meta with €805m fine over privacy law violation

europe_now.title: Widespread Anti-Government Demonstrations in France
europe_now.summary: France has deployed tens of thousands of security personnel as nationwide protests enter a fifth consecutive week over living costs and policing policies. Student mobilizations and labor grievances continue to generate significant domestic security pressures.

sources.headline: France protests for fifth Saturday against living costs and heavy-handed policing
Live: France deploys 70,000 police for new wave of anti-government protests

top_stories.title: Ukraine Territorial Proposals and Security Discussions
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian leadership stated that international partners suggested territorial concessions in exchange for alliance membership. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also indicated that any prospective security arrangements could be submitted to a national referendum.

top_stories.title: Hungarian Corruption Investigation and Financial Discovery
top_stories.summary: Investigative authorities in Hungary uncovered millions of euros in hidden and buried cash during an inquiry connected to a former Orbán-era minister. The high-profile corruption probe has drawn intense public interest across the region.
